concepts.label: Funding standard carryover balance
concepts.definition: A balance that the plan sponsor of an eligible single-employer plan maintaining a funding standard account in 2007 may elect to maintain until it is reduced to zero.
concepts.quote: the plan sponsor may elect to maintain a funding standard carryover balance, until such balance is reduced to zero.

scope_quotes: In the case of a single-employer plan described in clause (ii)

A plan is described in this clause if the plan—

(I) was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007, and

(II) had a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) of this title as in effect for such plan year and determined as of the end of such plan year.
